```yaml
name: Debug OCI

on:
  push:
    branches: [develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [develop]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:13
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: onetimesecret_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      redis:
        image: redis:6
        ports:
          - 6379:6379

    env:
      RAILS_ENV: test
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/onetimesecret_test
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
      # Add any other env vars required by the app here

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.1

      - name: Install Ruby dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run database migrations
        run: bundle exec rails db:migrate

      - name: Clean databases (dry‑run)
        run: ruby .github/scripts/clean_databases.rb --dry-run

      - name: Run backend tests
        run: bundle exec rspec

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: pnpm run playwright

      - name: Run tryouts
        run: pnpm run test:tryouts:agent

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: Test Results
          path: ./coverage/junit.xml
          reporter: jest

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: success()
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage/lcov.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
```
